findings.title: Regression guard receipts state failure propositions after passing
evidence: The submitted repair commit 7a4f3b0e2fcd3d02ac2d3712fd53cad6715fff88 is not an ancestor of the audited commit, which retains scripts/20_test_checks.py:19-24: expect() prints the same msg on both the pass and failure branches.

An isolated-clone run exits 0 but group [41] prints `ok AUDIT_CORRECTIONS_CYCLE1.md:101 count 36 != current 45 and is not marked historical`, despite AUDIT_CORRECTIONS_CYCLE1.md:98 explicitly marking that record historical. Group [44] also prints `ok ... current entry missing on disk` after successful path-existence predicates.

reproduce: python3 scripts/20_test_checks.py | sed -n '/\[41\]/,/\[42\]/p;/\[44\]/,/\[45\]/p'; nl -ba scripts/20_test_checks.py | sed -n '19,25p;1129,1155p;1247,1268p'; nl -ba AUDIT_CORRECTIONS_CYCLE1.md | sed -n '96,107p'; git merge-base --is-ancestor 7a4f3b0e2fcd3d02ac2d3712fd53cad6715fff88 HEAD; printf 'repair_ancestor_rc=%s\n' "$?"

proposed_check: C-GUARD-003 — execute accepted and rejected committed fixtures for the count and staging receipt scanners; require accepted fixtures to emit satisfied-condition wording and rejected fixtures to emit violation wording, and AST-reject any violation-shaped expect() call without an explicit success message.

summary: BLOCK: F-024 remains open because the audited commit predates its submitted repair and its passing regression receipts still assert failure propositions. Tier-0 HARD checks are PASS; the blocker is independently demonstrated judgment evidence.

coverage.method: Read navigation, canonical-index, authority, protocol, manifest, raw-output, derivation, XRD, and regression artifacts selected by RESULTS_INDEX and prior open finding F-024; independently executed the regression suite and three key recomputations in an isolated detached clone.
not_examined: Full manual semantic review of all 482 tracked paths, including historical archive material and every individual raw XRD scan, was not performed; Tier-0 supplied tree-wide deterministic checks.
